item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Well here we are. The second to final chapter. This is the shortest chapter in the series, coming in at 2,200 something words I think. Regardless, we come back to some of my favorite side characters. Always happy to have the chance to write more 3T. It makes me joyous inside, 'cause he's my little baby. Plus, Percy Pinwheel deserved to not be a one off character. Also, Polly Gary Ashley comes back and gets more screen time! All the old cast! The original cast! Hurray! These people were in the very first scene together! That's pretty neat!

Oh, and I loved writing that cliffhanger.

The next chapter is going to be fuuuun. And for everyone who read the last chapter, Deceptive Cadence, before it reached +10, there is an addition to the end of it that I forgot to put in it initially. I think that it's important foreshadowing for the last chapter, so I encourage people to go back and read that.

One more chapter, guys.
